signals.title: Quantum Systems more than doubles valuation in five months
signals.whatChanged: Quantum Systems raised a EUR 600M round in May 2026 at roughly a EUR 7B valuation, then closed a $1.2B Series D in July 2026 at an $8B post-money valuation, more than doubling in under five months. This is a real, sourced pattern, not a placeholder.
signals.evidence: Two independent official rounds, three months apart, both publicly reported
